title: ICSI CS Professional Programme June 2026 Results Announced!
content:
# ICSI CS Professional Programme June 2026 Results Announced!

Ek important update hai! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne CS Professional Programme June 2026 ke results aaj, August 25, 2026 ko declare kar diye hain.

Here are the key details:

*   **Result Declaration Date:** August 25, 2026.
*   **Declaration Time:** The results for the Professional Programme (Syllabus 2022) were announced at 11:00 A.M.
*   **How to Check:** Candidates can check their results and download their e-Marksheets from the official ICSI website by entering their roll number and 17-digit registration number.
*   **Marks Statement:** The formal Result-cum-Marks Statement for the Professional Programme (Syllabus 2022) Examination will be dispatched to candidates at their registered addresses soon after the declaration of results.
*   **Top Rank Holders:** Khushi Agarwal and Sania Sameer Khan have jointly secured Rank 1 in the CS Professional June 2026 examination.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Check Your CS Professional Programme June 2026 Results Here](https://www.icsi.edu/home/examination-results)
